purpose: Create the second scaled-agent lane-depth and public-explainability packet set for the Wave 2 human-service lanes: Income security and family, Education and workforce, and Veterans.

lane_packets.what_it_does: Tracks federal cash, tax-benefit, food, housing, childcare, and family-support commitments while keeping benefit design, take-up, state/local delivery, employer mandates, and household outcomes separate before any target or rate conclusion.

what_taxpayers_pay_now.required_next: official annual current-law path plus benefit package, take-up, refundable-credit, childcare-service, housing-support, and state/local translation evidence

lane_packets.who_is_served_or_protected: Children, families with low or unstable income, caregivers, workers in transition, households receiving food or housing support, and taxpayers funding income-security commitments.
lane_packets.overspending_underfunding_boundary: A high cost, low take-up, or poor outcome signal is review-needed only; it is not a savings estimate, benefit-cut instruction, waste finding, or fraud finding without matched population, benefit, outcome, administrative, and causal evidence.
lane_packets.technology_transition_boundary: Eligibility, enrollment, recertification, payment accuracy, childcare-provider systems, case management, appeals, privacy, cybersecurity, and service access must be costed as transition work before any modernization credit.
lane_packets.comparison_boundary: SOCX old-age/family evidence is descriptive public family-benefit cash/services context only. International spending differences are not savings. Spending level alone is not overspending.

lane_packets.what_it_does: Tracks federal education, training, employment, and social-service commitments while separating federal aid from state, local, household, and employer spending before using any peer or outcome comparison.

what_taxpayers_pay_now.required_next: official annual function path, federal-state-local translation, cohort-compatible program costs, and education/workforce outcome evidence

lane_packets.who_is_served_or_protected: Students, families, workers, job seekers, schools, training participants, student-aid recipients, and communities affected by educational access and workforce outcomes.
lane_packets.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Negative higher-education net outlays, Pell or WIOA outcome signals, or peer education differences are review-needed context only; they are not cash-equivalence, fiscal savings, fraud, waste, or a target level.
lane_packets.technology_transition_boundary: Student-aid administration, credential data, workforce case management, fraud/error controls, privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility, and school/training-provider adoption costs must be modeled before any technology credit.
lane_packets.federal_state_local_translation_boundary: OMB Function 500 is federal outlays only. K-12 is mostly state/local financed, and federal outlays cannot be added on top of school-system totals that already include federal revenue.
lane_packets.higher_education_negative_entry_boundary: The -$35.005B higher-education entry is not negative education, not cash savings, not waste, and not fraud.

lane_packets.what_it_does: Tracks earned veterans benefits and services, including disability and pension support, veterans health care, education and rehabilitation, housing, claims processing, and other statutory commitments.

what_taxpayers_pay_now.required_next: official annual veterans path plus eligible cohort, service package, medical enrollment, claims, housing, education, and outcome evidence

lane_packets.who_is_served_or_protected: Veterans, disabled veterans, survivors and dependents, enrolled veterans receiving medical care, veterans using education or rehabilitation benefits, veterans needing housing support, and taxpayers funding earned commitments.
lane_packets.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Claims backlog, quality, or component-cost probes are service review signals only; they are not savings estimates, waste findings, fraud findings, benefit-cut instructions, or authority to reduce earned eligibility.
lane_packets.technology_transition_boundary: Claims systems, medical scheduling, records exchange, appeals workflow, housing case management, accessibility, privacy, cybersecurity, and fallback service capacity must be costed before any modernization credit.
lane_packets.statutory_continuity_boundary: Veterans benefits and services are earned statutory obligations. A lower-cost scenario is inadmissible unless continuity of legally required benefits and access to promised services is preserved.
lane_packets.service_probe_boundary: Claims backlog and quality probes are review signals only. They are not whole-lane performance findings, fraud findings, waste findings, savings estimates, or department cut instructions.

plain_english_status: Wave 2 now has human-service lane-depth explainability scaffolds for Income security and family, Education and workforce, and Veterans. These packets explain what each lane does, who is served, what outcomes matter, where overspending or underfunding review signals may arise, and what technology transition work would need to be modeled. They do not complete lane depth, calculate rates, publish target costs, claim savings, identify waste or fraud, direct department cuts, claim technology savings, run the solver, or claim a balanced budget.
